rules.statement: When two parties have agreed for the conveyance of a definite corpus from one to the other, the vendor cannot derogate from his own grant by setting up the plea that he was not in fact entitled to so much as he granted, but that he has another interest in the property which he has never conveyed, and which he retains to himself. The heir of the vendor must be in the same position.
